model.name: Public Authority / Institution
model.purpose: Describe a public institution and its source-qualified legal competence, institutional structure and accountability context.
model.scope_statement: One public institution, potentially lacking separate legal personality, with evidenced identity, basis, competence, relationships and institutional changes. Classification is not proof of powers.
in_scope: Institution identity, classifications, legal basis and bounded competence assertions
Organs, oversight, service responsibility and public contact references
Transparency, evidence custody, succession and loss-aware mappings
out_of_scope: A sovereign state, individual officeholder, building or full service catalogue
Legal advice, automatic power inference, policy enforcement or government decision execution
Private personnel, case files and complete financial or statutory instrument masters

boundary_notes.distinction: Public institutional specialization is conceptual; registry parent WM-ORG-001 is not a ratified inherited schema.
Responsible institution and delivery provider differ; service details stay referenced.
Institution persists through vacancies; a post and its current holder have distinct records.
Statistical public control does not decide independence or legal competence.
Address or office presence is not institutional identity or jurisdiction.

composition.purpose: Candidate general organization alignment, not ratified inheritance.
Posts, sites and changes, without legal-power entailment.
Referenced service responsibility, not a full service model.

owner_package_requirements: Declare institution-record steward distinct from the institution and its legal authorities.
Register official institution, instrument, service and evidence masters.
Bind attribution, interpretation, access, disclosure, correction and retention policies.
dimension.namespace_guidance: Use qualified institution identifiers and independent instrument/post/service references; preserve source jurisdiction and revision.

canonicalization_rules: Preserve classifications with their schemes and authority; never infer powers from a category.
Keep institutional effective time, evidence observation and local recording time distinct.
patch_rules: Pin base version/digest; namespace jurisdiction and institution-type extensions.
Append source-qualified corrections under expected-head checks; unresolved competing authority remains visible.
compatibility_rules: Renaming is not automatically a successor institution.
Reject projection losing required competence, time, identity or disclosure qualifiers.

artifact_rules.timestamp_rule: Use RFC 3339 seconds and explicit offset or Z for recording instants; preserve date-only and uncertain legal effect separately.
artifact_rules.serial_naming_rule: Opaque institution ID plus record kind and revision; no restricted personnel or case details in names.
artifact_rules.integrity_rule: Verify exact-byte digest and source revision; integrity is not legal authority or authentic institutional mandate.

policies: Local memory edits do not create, abolish or change an institution or legal competence.
Do not infer public power from a website, funding, classification, service delivery or reporting line.
Public information access does not grant universal redistribution or authority to act.
Preserve unknown personality, disputed competence and missing information without fabrication.

read: Read Dimension authority, pinned specification, assurance holds and evidence access policy before institution records.
create: Record source-qualified institutional assertions within delegated local scope; do not invent legal facts.
update: Append changes with instrument/source references, effective time, reason and expected-head guard.
delete: Apply authorized retention and legal-hold policy to local copies; retain only permitted minimal tombstones. Deletion does not abolish an institution or erase public obligations.

roles.name: Dimension owner
responsibilities: Delegates local memory scope, not government powers.

roles.name: Institution steward
responsibilities: Maintains attributed identity and mandate references.

roles.name: Contributor
responsibilities: Supplies authorized source references and uncertainty.

roles.name: Reviewer
responsibilities: Checks boundary, profile and interpretation limits.

roles.name: Custodian
responsibilities: Enforces access, disclosure and retention policies.

access.default_rule: Deny absent scope-specific authority; public institutional identity does not make every linked record public.
exceptions: Explicit scoped time-limited exception with authorizer and rationale; never implied by a government label.
audit_requirements: Record operation, opaque object/revision and authorized outcome without secrets or restricted source contents.

read_order: Dimension scope and institutional evidence policy
Identity, legal basis and qualified competence
Authorized record operations, projection checks and retirement

coverage.claim: Bounded public-institution memory draft, not universal administrative law or independently reviewed legal engine.

checklist.notes: Institution distinct from names, sites and holders.
Legal personality, level, basis and scope explicitly qualified.
Official evidence and identity ambiguity, not website inference.
Record operations distinct from real legal powers.
Foundation, reorganization, succession and local retirement.
Posts, oversight, services and instruments referenced.
Legal effect and observation time separated.
Record steward does not own government power.
Custody and legal holds bound local retirement.
Research schema checked; nested schemas, legal-profile rules and negative runtime fixtures not implemented.
Institution is organizational; physical properties belong to referenced sites and assets.

known_omissions: Both providers timed out once; no independent external review.
Selected clauses only; full dated-pin/update/license and jurisdiction-profile verification pending.
No concrete institution-specific legal instrument or universal competence interpretation supplied.
No executable nested schemas, legal inference engine, succession/custody transfer or round-trip adapter.
Empty relation ledger; proposed composition has not been ratified.
regional_assumptions: UK administrative/statistical/FOI examples are bounded and do not define all public institutions worldwide.
adversarial_checks: Public control classification does not negate institutional independence.
A distinct agency may lack separate legal personality.
Outsourcing does not alone change responsible authority.
A vacant post is distinct from a nonexistent institution.
A site is not a jurisdiction.
Reporting is not necessarily legal delegation.
Name change is not automatically succession.
Public scheme does not authorize every record disclosure.
Local edits cannot confer or abolish government powers.
